environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). ALB access logs enabled to S3. Instance runs in a public subnet with a NAT gateway. No additional request filtering or inspection layers. Flask app served via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database stored on EBS volume at /data/app.db containing production user records including admin accounts with api_key values populated.
